slug: 2024-10-08 Central African Republic in full biometric voter registration preparations

systems.platform: GenKey biometric enrolment software and hardware; at least 3,000 enrolment tablets
systems.tiers: national registration drive planned to run to 30 December 2024

systems.owner: Al Madina, the security printing company producing the card
systems.tiers: issued only in the capital because of insecurity; an enrolment centre opened in Bambari

note: On the biometric electoral register and the identity card; the birth certificate is named only as an accepted proof of identity.
